mapper.select: SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, OI.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, OI.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, OI.BUSINESS_NO AS businessNo, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, OI.QUANTITY AS quantity, OI.STATUS AS status FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND O.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND OI.STATUS IN ('ORDERED', 'PAID', 'PREPARING') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DELIVERY D WHERE D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND D.STATUS IN ('SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED') ) ORDER BY OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDER_ITEM SET STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST' WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS IN ('ORDERED', 'PAID', 'PREPARING')
mapper.select: SELECT CR.CANCEL_NO, CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.ORDER_NO, CR.MEMBER_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, (OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY) AS CANCEL_AMOUNT, CR.REASON, CR.STATUS, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.PROCESSED_AT, CR.REJECT_REASON FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CR.CANCEL_NO = #{cancelNo} AND OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE CANCEL_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', PROCESSED_AT = SYSDATE, REJECT_REASON = NULL WHERE CANCEL_NO = #{cancelNo} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
UPDATE ORDER_ITEM SET STATUS = 'PAID' WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST'
UPDATE ORDER_ITEM SET STATUS = 'CANCELED' WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST'

UPDATE ORDERS O SET O.ORDER_STATUS = ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'CANCELED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CANCEL_REQUEST' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL_CANCELED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'SHIPPING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'SHIPPING' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'PREPARING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PREPARING' ELSE 'PAID' END FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ) WHERE O.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
